Night gathers in a broad basin of dark, uneven hills. Beneath a cold blue-gray, faintly starry sky, light mist softens the distant slopes and tree line; rolling, softly eroded ground rises around nearly every side in shallow ridges, hollows, and steepening slopes, forming the scene’s outer boundary.

Its long rectangular wings trace a large squared C- or U-shaped footprint around a recessed entrance court and a smaller projecting central block. Flat or very shallow dark roofs, pale cornices, and repeated tall, narrow windows give the abandoned institution its rhythm. The main façade faces the wooded grounds; behind it, a simpler continuous institutional wall takes over.

Dark chain-link fencing and gates enclose parts of the immediate grounds. Low rough stone borders, sparse paths or worn drives, scattered rocks and shrubs, and a few small ornamental plantings gather near the building. An irregular grove mixes mature deciduous trees with thinner, columnar trees, densest around the façade and sides and thinning naturally toward the hills. Organically spaced isolated trunks and small clusters cast long shadows. The abandoned institutional complex forms a single building cluster occupying only a small portion of this expansive, dark landscape, leaving the whole composition sparse, secluded, and isolated.
